name: claude-session-optimizer
description: claude-session-optimizer — Compress oversized Claude Code session files. Recovers disk space and prevents 75MB+ crash. Zero dependencies.

commands.description: Download compress-claude-session script from GitHub to ~/.local/bin/

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Requires curl. Run manually: mkdir -p ~/.local/bin && curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/javimosch/claude-session-optimizer/main/compress-claude-session.py -o ~/.local/bin/compress-claude-session && chmod +x ~/.local/bin/compress-claude-session

commands.description: List all Claude Code sessions sorted by size, with status flags for oversized ones
Compress all sessions over 50 MB threshold. Creates .bak backups first.
Preview compression savings without modifying any files. Shows exactly what would be removed/truncated.
Compress all sessions over a custom MB threshold. Example: --threshold 30 compresses everything over 30 MB.
Compress a specific session file. Provide the full path to the .jsonl file.

args.name: path
args.description: Full path to the .jsonl session file (e.g., ~/.claude/projects/-my-project/uuid.jsonl)

commands.description: Teach the agent how to use claude-session-optimizer. Run: sc skills teach claude-session-optimizer:quickstart
🔍 One-command health check: auto-installs optimizer (cached to ~/.local/bin), scans all sessions, reports oversized ones, and gives guidance on next steps. Safe — never modifies files.

baseArgs: BIN=$HOME/.local/bin/compress-claude-session; if ! [ -x "$BIN" ]; then mkdir -p $HOME/.local/bin && echo 'Downloading claude-session-optimizer...' && curl -sL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/javimosch/claude-session-optimizer/main/compress-claude-session.py -o "$BIN" && chmod +x "$BIN" && echo 'Installed to $BIN'; fi; export PATH=$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH; echo ''; python3 "$BIN" --list; LARGE=$(python3 "$BIN" --list 2>/dev/null | grep -c 'LARGE'); TOTAL=$(python3 "$BIN" --list 2>/dev/null | tail -1); echo '---'; if [ "$LARGE" -gt 0 ]; then echo "Oversized sessions: $LARGE"; echo 'To compress: sc claude-session-optimizer self compress'; echo 'Or set threshold: sc claude-session-optimizer self compress-threshold --threshold 30'; else echo 'All sessions are under 50 MB - nothing to compress.'; fi; echo "$TOTAL"

commands.description: Passthrough: run any raw compress-claude-session command. Example: claude-session-optimizer _ _ --threshold 30 --dry-run
